name: TD-MPC2
summary: TD-MPC2 learns an implicit, decoder-free latent world model trained via temporal-difference losses, and plans with short-horizon model predictive control bootstrapped by a learned value function. A single 317M-parameter agent handles 104 tasks across four domains with multiple embodiments and action spaces, using one hyperparameter set.
innovation: Decoder-free latent dynamics avoiding pixel reconstruction entirely.
Hybrid short-horizon planning with terminal value bootstrapping, combining model-based and model-free strengths.
matters: Shows value-equivalent world models scale to massively multitask continuous control.
limits: Proprioceptive and simulation-centric; visual real-world manipulation is not its strong suit.
lineage: MuZero's value-equivalence idea adapted to continuous control with MPC instead of tree search.
